title: mohria marginalis
intro: Mohria marginalis, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Blechnaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering numerous health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and fighting against oxidative stress, which may contribute to the prevention of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Mohria marginalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
